text:
Silver Price in 1997
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1997, the LBMA silver price rose 20.9% between 1997-01-31 ($4.96) and 1997-12-31 ($6.00). The highest sampled price was $6.00 in December and the lowest was $4.38 in July. The mean of these observations was $5.00. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
